decisions.base: 199 actual cards: #1-170 excluding nonexistent #28; #S171-S198; #CK1-CK2. All equal base probability.
decisions.rookies: 34 indexed true rookies; only base gets RC suffix.
decisions.parallels: Three physical parallel families: 50-Point /3000, 50-Point Gold /150, HoloGold /10, each 199 actual cards.
decisions.inserts: Nine TCDB insert families; only direct physical pack-inserted cards included. Gold Set Redemption 1:6000; redeemed factory set itself excluded.
decisions.excluded: Gold Exchange (SN100/SN500) are mail-in complete factory sets, not directly pulled singles. Omit promo/proof sets and other-product Odyssey autos.
decisions.numbering: Do not invent base #28. For duplicate Super Masters #SN20 treat separate subjects with unique checklist identities, preserve real #SN19 anomaly.
decisions.names: Only strip full whitespace/comma-delimited metadata tokens; never truncate surname letters.
decisions.odds: Only Gold Set Redemption has verified 1:6000 pack rate. Other unspecified odds remain null.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft; source checksum, images/pricing/odds and quality assurance pending.
